hypotheses.C0_probe_overlap_converges: Independent top-64 operator bases reach at least 0.80 overlap at 4096 probes in every sampled layer.
hypotheses.C1_operator_reconstruction_beats_pca_aft: At 4096 probes, operator rank-64 held-out R2 exceeds state-PCA rank-64 in every sampled layer.
hypotheses.C2_semantic_axis_advantage_replicates: Both independent 4096-probe bases exceed their own matched-rotation p95 median single-axis AUROC by at least 0.02 in every sampled layer.
hypotheses.C3_semantic_axis_identity_replicates: Matched top-64 operator axes have mean absolute semantic profile correlation at least 0.70 after optimal absolute-cosine matching.
